info.title: Almohit Hotels API
info.description:
RESTful API for Almohit Hotels platform. Provides hotel listings, room types,
bookings, reviews, services, and image management with role-based access control.

**Auth:** Bearer token via `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.
**Tenant:** Subdomain via `X-Hotel-Subdomain` header or hostname.
**Pagination:** DRF-compatible `{ count, next, previous, results }`.
**Errors:** snake_case JSON `{ detail, code }`.

BearerAuth.description:
Accepts both `Bearer <token>` and `Token <token>` formats.
Token returned from `/api/auth/login/` as `access` field.
